ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast characterized by approximately 60-65% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 35-40% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch area and basal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric regions occupy the outer lobes. A central, wide black V-shaped region extends from the peduncle toward the trailing edge. A high-frequency speckled transition zone (mottling) is visible at the interior boundaries of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep V-shaped central depression is visible with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 60 degrees and a significant depth ratio relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The boundary displays high-frequency serrations across the entire extent. Distinct jagged peaks and valleys are concentrated at the distal tips, showing irregular pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve from the central notch toward the tips, showing an upward parabolic sweep on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-contrast circular clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization are located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the white-pigmented areas, including a prominent diagonal mark on the mid-right lobe and several horizontal marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized trauma or parasitic attachments visible as raised calcified textures on the outer trailing edges; numerous linear rake-mark scars on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique salt-and-pepper mottling pattern at the interface of the central black pigmentation and the lateral white fields.
